description: Use official MicroG-RE 7.2.2 for Google Maps and synthesized navigation speech, start Google TTS before guidance, skip the uncertified-device screen and avoid a crash when a location-settings dialog cannot open. Includes an opt-in native EV model experiment that sends BYD battery data and estimated road-load coefficients to Google. Arrival forecasts and navigation display remain experimental. Requires Morphe Desktop 1.19.0 or newer.
